name: machine-bridge-mcp
description: Cross-client MCP bridge for local agent context, structured browser and application automation, files, Git, processes, resources, and durable jobs over stdio or OAuth relay.

scripts.version: node scripts/sync-worker-version.mjs && git add package.json package-lock.json src/worker/index.ts browser-extension/manifest.json
scripts.prepack: npm run version:check && npm run privacy:check && npm run release-impact:check
scripts.prepublishOnly: node scripts/assert-publishable-manifest.mjs && npm run publication:check && npm run version:check && node scripts/github-release.mjs --check
scripts.typecheck: npm run worker:types && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck:local
scripts.lint: eslint eslint.config.mjs bin src/local src/shared scripts tests browser-extension .github/scripts
